decisive_items: Lesion next to right lower hilar (3.79 × 5.82cm)
response.rationale: Imaging and IHC (CK7+, AE1/AE3+, TTF1−) support a non-small cell lung cancer; P63/P40 negativity argues against squamous cell carcinoma, while KEAP1 mutation is a molecular feature not a primary histologic diagnosis.

rejected.why: P63 and P40 are negative, which contradicts squamous differentiation despite CK5/6 positivity.
KEAP1 mutation is a genetic alteration, not a definitive histologic diagnosis; it lacks tissue-specific support.
